attchmntText: Sansera Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Sansera Engineering Limited intimates that its officials will attend an investor conference organized by Avendus Spark in Mumbai on 17th November 2026 starting at 09:00 AM. The meeting will consist of one-on-one or group interactions. The company states that discussions will be limited to publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be shared during these sessions. The notice acknowledges that changes to the schedule may occur due to exigencies. This communication is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The intimation was signed by Rajesh Kumar Modi, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Sansera Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Sansera Engineering Limited intimates that its officials will attend a one-on-one or group meeting with CLSA in Mumbai on 16th November 2026 at 10:00 AM onwards. The interaction is part of the scheduled analyst and institutional investor meetings. The company confirms that only publicly available information will be discussed. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be shared during the session. The company notes that changes to the schedule may occur due to exigencies. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The notice was issued on 9th November 2026 by Rajesh Kumar Modi, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Sansera Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sansera Engineering Limited published unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, in Business Standard and Prajavani newspapers. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 5, 2026. G.S. Auto International Limited approved unaudited financial results for the same period on November 6, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 305.37 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Rain Industries Limited fixed November 13, 2026, as the record date for an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share. Siemens Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, on November 6, 2026. AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited approved unaudited financial results on November 5, 2026, reporting a net profit of 623.3 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. IRIS IRIS RegTech Solutions Limited published unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, showing a net profit of 109.37 lakhs for the quarter.
